ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels on the right lobe versus low-intensity dark-gray/black pixels on the left lobe and distal borders.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe: Broad contiguous white/light-gray base with scattered low-intensity dark punctate spots (mottling). Left lobe: Predominantly low-intensity dark-gray/black with minimal light-gray longitudinal streaks. High-contrast black border along the entire trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the fluke center with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations across both lobes; distinct high-amplitude indentation located on the right lobe approximately 20% distance from the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe exhibits a convex parabolic curve trailing toward the tip; left lobe exhibits a linear downward sweep with slight concavity near the center.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of high-intensity white circular pixel groups (barnacle attachments) localized on the distal tip of the right lobe; scattered dark circular spots across the light right-lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple horizontal dark-gray linear streaks (rake marks) cutting across the light-gray surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (rosettes) present on the right fluke tip and along the left fluke leading edge tip; numerous linear scratches on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Suspended water droplets and splash-pattern pixels visible trailing from the entire length of the trailing edge boundary.
